description: Retrieve YouTube transcripts and subtitles, summarize or analyze what was said, or save an Obsidian-ready Markdown knowledge-base note with captions, creator metadata, chapters, language, and source provenance. Use for a YouTube URL or video ID when the request needs spoken content or an archival note. A bare YouTube link defaults to saving a note.
